node.statement: The direct sum B=oplus_{C in C}M_{|C|} is a finite-dimensional C*-algebra. Because v is a current reset isomorphism, def-maincb-reset-state and def-extended-delta-inclusion make it an extended d_J^out-isomorphism. The inequalities d_J^out<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_J^out<=W.c0_cb*W.L*epsilon<=W.c0_cb*W.K_call*epsilon and lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone make v an extended W.c0_cb*W.K_call*epsilon-isomorphism. Finally A_J=A and u_{A_J}=R, so the triangle inequality, ||R-I_A||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon, and W.K_call>=W.L+1 from lem-maincb-witness-arithmetic give ||v(I_B)-I_A||<=W.c0_cb*W.L*epsilon+W.c0_cb*epsilon<=W.c0_cb*W.K_call*epsilon.
